items.title: Stock Market LIVE: Sensex trades 100 pts lower, Nifty below 24,450
items.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates Wednesday: In the broader markets, the Nifty MidCap was down 0.09 per cent, and the Nifty SmallCap rose 0.07 per cent

items.title: India's retail traders lose $9.6 billion in options despite curbs
items.description: The losses eased slightly from ₹1.1 trillion a year earlier, while the number of traders fell to fewer than 8 million from 9.8 million, according to a written reply by MoS Finance Pankaj Chaudhary

items.description: Tata Motors, Petronet LNG, Apollo Hospitals, IRCTC among companies set to announce Q1FY27 results today.

items.title: Tata Capital, Orient Electric: HDFC Securities shares trading strategy
items.description: Technical picks: Vinay Rajani of HDFC Securities has recommended two stocks to buy today -- Tata Capital and Orient Electric.

items.title: Nifty faces 24,500 hurdle; Divi's Labs, MCX, Eternal on analyst radar
items.description: Chandan Taparia of Motilal Oswal Financial Services has recommended three stocks to buy today: Divi's Laboratories, MCX, and Eternal.

items.title: Godrej Consumer Products CEO Sitapati's exit triggers 10% slide in stock
items.description: Analysts believe the unexpected leadership transition could weigh on Godrej Consumer Products stock in the near term, but do not expect any change in the company's core strategy.

items.title: Tata group stocks may shrug off reports of Chandra's exit: Analysts
items.description: Chandra's current term as chairman runs until February 2027, but the continuation hinges on his reappointment as a director of Tata Sons

items.title: Ardee Industries makes strong debut, shares list at 39% premium
items.description: Ardee Industries shares opened at ₹72 on the NSE, up ₹19 apiece or 35.85 per cent, compared with the IPO issue price of ₹53. On the BSE, the shares debuted at ₹73.60, up ₹20.60 or 38.87 per cent.

items.title: Most Tata group stocks trade lower amid reports of Chandrasekaran's exit
items.description: Most of the group stocks traded with cuts of up to 1 per cent in early trade on the NSE. Tejas Networks was the top loser.

items.title: Manappuram Finance up 3% as Q1 PAT jumps 4x; gold loan AUM nearly doubles
items.description: Manappuram Finance reported consolidated profit of Rs 585 crore for the first quarter ended June 30, 2026, compared to a profit of Rs 132 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous year.
